title: Six-stage Rube Goldberg
description: A cue ball rides a ramp, a conveyor and a swing gate, topples dominoes, and a seesaw flips a ball into a box.
goal: The plastic ball flies into the box

title: Domino effect
description: 24 dominoes run into a growing row that ends in a half-metre giant; it knocks the 8-ball into a bucket.
goal: The giant knocks the 8-ball into the bucket

title: Zig-zag marble run
description: A glass marble zig-zags down five ramps and drops into a cup at the bottom.
goal: The marble ends in the cup

title: Catapult into a bucket
description: A spring catapult lobs a tennis ball over a traffic cone into a bucket 1.5 m away.
goal: The tennis ball sails over the cone into the bucket

title: Newton's cradle relay
description: The cradle's click topples ten growing dominoes, and the last one tips the 8-ball into a cup.

title: Seesaw launch
description: A 1 kg steel weight drops on a seesaw and catapults a tennis ball into a basket on a high shelf.
goal: The tennis ball lands in the basket on the shelf

title: Counterweight lift
description: A falling 1.2 kg counterweight hauls a pail with an apple almost half a metre up, then lands on a pillow.
goal: The counterweight lands on the pillow

title: Bowling strike
description: A 7 kg bowling ball rolls off a steep ramp and knocks down all ten pins.
goal: All ten pins fall: a strike

title: Bounce chain
description: A superball rolls off a high ramp and hops across three bounce pads into a basket.
goal: The superball lands in the basket

title: Wrecking-ball combo
description: A wrecking ball clips a brick off a tower; it slams a seesaw that flips a tennis ball into a bucket.
goal: The tennis ball drops into the bucket
